title: Entity history row
responsibility: A compact commit row: relative date with exact timestamp on hover, commit link, behavior, source size, complexity and measured latency. Long reasons use an inline disclosure; no verdict or duplicate revision control.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.row
inputs.description: The commit row this component shows: committedAt gives the relative date with the exact timestamp as hover text, the first seven characters of commit are the link text, and subject, bounded to the subject writing limit, stands in for behavior text when the detail has none. Size and complexity come from measured and fall back to the detail's sourceSize and sourceComplexity when measured has no value; sizeChange and complexityChange are signed deltas, and an approval review adds a Budget increase approved badge.

examples.subject: Tidy explorer copy
examples.author: Sam Okafor
examples.gap: This history was built before it recorded what each commit changed.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.detail
inputs.description: The loaded revision detail of this entity at this commit, or undefined until its revision has been read. Its explanations are summarized by entityReasons and the summary is passed to EntityReasons; its sourceSize and sourceComplexity fill in a size or complexity the row does not measure, and the row shows its subject instead when no behavior text is summarized.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.timing
inputs.description: The timing of the chosen profile at this commit, or undefined when it has none. It shows before → after in its unit when a before value exists, after alone otherwise, and Not measured when the timing is undefined.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.verdict
inputs.description: Optional legacy verdict with passed, label and reasons. The props type accepts it, but the component never reads it, so this compact commit row renders no verdict.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.selected
inputs.description: Optional legacy selection flag. The props type accepts it, but the component never reads it; the viewed flag alone marks the displayed commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.viewed
inputs.description: Required flag for the commit being viewed: when true, the row gets the viewed class and a Viewed commit badge beside its hash link.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.to
inputs.description: Required location that the commit hash links to, meaning the entity at this commit, which the source compares with its own parent. It is passed unchanged to EntityLink together with nav.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context (EntityNav: route, href and go, plus an optional source), passed unchanged to EntityLink together with to, which wraps the commit hash.

inputs.name: EntityHistoryRow.onselect
inputs.description: Optional legacy selection callback declared in the props type; the component never calls it, because the commit link is an EntityLink driven by to and nav.

outputs.name: EntityHistoryRow
outputs.description: The row element hx-tr, carrying data-harness-component harness-entity-history-row and the viewed class when viewed, with six cells: the relative date with the exact timestamp as its title, the short commit link with the Viewed commit badge and summarized reasons, the behavior text or subject, the size with its signed change and, when approved, a Budget increase approved badge, the complexity with its signed change, and the timing or Not measured.
